purpose: A layered geographic framework for research coverage, fieldwork planning and map navigation. Administrative boundaries and working zones are separate layers.
boundary_policy: Use the 2026 Tailte Éireann Local Authorities dataset as the primary administrative coverage framework for Dublin City Council, Fingal County Council, South Dublin County Council and Dún Laoghaire-Rathdown County Council.
Use Tailte Éireann 2026 townlands as the fine-grained statutory research geography after checking the dataset's reuse terms and metadata.
Postal districts are operational work zones only. Never use a postal district label as proof that an object lies inside a local-authority boundary.
Do not publish or redistribute copied boundary geometry until the applicable licence and attribution conditions are confirmed.
Where an object's coordinates are absent, source-derived at property level, or too imprecise for a boundary decision, leave local-authority assignment unresolved.
Do not count a source-derived building centroid as an exact micro-detail location.
Neighbourhoods, parks, corridors and coastal zones may be overlapping fieldwork zones, not substitutes for statutory administrative geography.
Coverage status describes archive research and fieldwork only; it never implies that a whole area has been exhaustively surveyed.

local_authorities.name: Dublin City Council
local_authorities.coverage_notes: The catalogue has a substantial research sample in central and inner Dublin, but no object has been counted against this local-authority polygon layer in the Step 4 audit. The 274 catalogue records are distributed across postal districts Dublin 1, 2, 3, 4 and 8; postal-district labels are not used as a substitute for spatial boundary assignment. Administrative-area record count remains unverified until each defensible point is intersected with the authoritative 2026 boundary dataset.

local_authorities.name: Fingal County Council
local_authorities.coverage_notes: No catalogue record count is assigned to this authority in the Step 4 audit. Research coverage is not yet established. Use the 2026 Tailte Éireann local-authority polygon as the administrative frame, then subdivide research by official townlands and documented settlements. Do not infer coverage from postal districts.

working_zone_layers.name: 2026 local-authority administrative boundaries
working_zone_layers.notes: Official Tailte Éireann 2026 ungeneralised polygon dataset; GeoJSON resource listed on data.gov.ie. Geometry not redistributed in this release because the dataset listing does not specify a reuse licence. Administrative assignment remains pending.

working_zone_layers.name: Dublin postal districts
working_zone_layers.notes: Operational discovery and fieldwork groupings only. Current record counts are reconciled against the master catalogue in data/coverage-audit.json. Not administrative boundaries.

working_zone_layers.name: Official townlands
working_zone_layers.notes: Tailte Éireann 2026 townlands dataset identified. Dataset page lists no licence; confirm reuse conditions before copying geometry. Use for fine-grained statutory research subdivision once cleared.

working_zone_layers.name: Neighbourhood and settlement zones
working_zone_layers.notes: Add named neighbourhoods and settlements as overlapping research groupings with documented provenance; boundaries may be informal.

working_zone_layers.name: Fieldwork routes and corridors
working_zone_layers.notes: Add walkable routes, streets, parks, waterfronts and heritage clusters after discovery research. A route is not an administrative area.

boundary_assignment_policy.coordinate_rule: Assign an object to a local authority only after a defensible object coordinate is spatially checked against the authoritative polygon. If coordinate precision is inadequate, leave assignment unresolved.
boundary_assignment_policy.micro_detail_rule: Do not assign a micro-detail using a parent building centroid unless the point is explicitly treated as an approximate context point and cannot change the authority assignment.
boundary_assignment_policy.geometry_publication: Pending licence review; do not bundle copied 2026 boundary geometry in this release.
